checks: A real pointer drag scans multiple food pieces and magnifies the actual 3D canvas. Release selects the view without cooking actions, time or evidence.
Escape cancels the lens overlay and leaves the cook unchanged.
Grabbing the lens pauses a running kitchen for an observation.
Keyboard selection and keeping a view pause the kitchen. Real turning and time advancement update only the current observation; the kept view remains intact.
Cut labels distinguish unequal widths; sketches show the recorded upward face. Text view offers the same observations and comparisons without changing the cook.
A fresh cook clears kept observations and disables the lens until food is in the pan.
Replay observes its historical pan frame, allows comparisons within that recording, and never reads the final dish as an earlier observation or alters stored evidence.
Real touch scans pieces at 390px, shows the magnifier, and leaves the cook unchanged with no horizontal overflow.
The lens fits 320px and forced colors. Graphics loss cancels an active lens and retains working observation controls.
